response.overview: Off the coast of California, a community haunted by decades of oil spills rises once more as Sable Offshore threatens to restart operations on a corroded pipeline in the Santa Barbara Channel. Through the voices of activists, fishermen, and longtime residents, Hydra on the Horizon traces the legacy of disaster, exposing the scars of the past and following a community in its urgent fight to break the cycle before it's too late.
response.tagline: A Santa Barbara community mobilizes against an offshore oil pipeline threatening their coast.
response.title: Hydra on the Horizon
